summary: 1.18.2 1.19.0 Manu proposes a patch release of Parquet Java 1.18.2 to include several critical fixes and dependency updates. The community, including Fokko and Steve, supports the release and is ready to review the backport PRs. Participants propose using metadata fields MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH to capture vector length and suggest that performance gains are unlikely, so enforcement must be handled by engines. The consensus leans toward introducing the logical type first, with potential future separation of finite and fixed-length variants.
